summary: Full E2E verification of the two new MedFind features passed. (1) AI Intake Assistant now returns all 7 fields — name/dose/form/quantity/transfer/has_rx/prescriber_call — and ready=true; intake-panel renders all 7 rows correctly and the large chat-continue-btn banner appears. (2) mf_pendingMed persists all 7 fields and PatientDashboard prefills req-name/dose/form/qty plus the three new toggles (req-transfer=on, req-prescription=on, req-prescriber=off) exactly as the AI identified. Submitting shows Transfer + Has Rx badges under My Requests. (3) Pharmacy (downtown@demo.com) accept flow still charges $4.99 (regression OK) and blind-view continues to hide patient identity. (4) Post-payment update dialog (post-update-btn -> post-field-Dose -> post-value-input '40mg confirmed' -> post-note-input -> post-update-submit) succeeded; success toast mentions $0.50; pharm-post-updates chip renders on the accepted card. (5) Earnings tab shows earnings-total updated by +$0.50, earnings-list contains the Post-payment update: Dose entry, and KPI Earnings card reflects total. (6) After logging back in as patient@demo.com the accepted Lipitor card shows patient-post-updates with 'Dose: 40mg confirmed — Prescriber verified' and Downtown Rx name, alongside contact-exchange. All backend endpoints exercised via pytest (7 relevant tests) pass 100%.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / DialogDescription — console warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined}'. Same on Clarify/Reject dialogs likely. Non-blocking accessibility warning.

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to post-update / clarify / reject DialogContent components to remove the Radix console warning.
(Optional) AIChat SESSION_ID is generated once per module load; consider regenerating on new conversations so anonymous sessions don't collide across reloads.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py post_update fee is hard-coded (POST_UPDATE_FEE=0.50). Consider env-driven like PLATFORM_FEE for symmetry.

PatientDashboard: prescriber toggle defaults from pending?.prescriber_call — good; but if the patient has_rx=true and prescriber_call=true, both are shown; UI does not validate mutual exclusion (backend also allows it). Acceptable, but might mislead pharmacies.

PharmacyDashboard AcceptedCard: FIELDS chips call setField(f) but the text Input post-field-input also lets users type; on quick submit, if a chip is clicked THEN user retypes, no issue. However clicking the same chip twice does not toggle off — minor UX.
AIChat: SESSION_ID module-level constant — resets only on full JS reload, all anonymous users in one tab share same session id (already noted in prior iteration).

server.py: post_update endpoint accepts any string for `field`. No length/whitelist validation. Consider limiting to ['Dose','Form','Quantity','Substitution','Stock status','Ready time'] or bounded length to avoid abuse of the $0.50 earning.
seed_data_creation: Created a live TEST_Lipitor-like Lipitor request via UI (patient@demo.com) and accepted+updated it with Downtown Rx to verify the $0.50 earning increment. Test data prefixed with TEST_ from the new pytest tests remains in Mongo (safe, blindly ignored).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new intake fields + post-update + earnings + patient-visible updates are working end-to-end on the preview URL. Regression checks (blind queue view, $4.99 accept fee, contact-exchange) still pass. Only nit: DialogContent lacks a11y description. Existing pytest suite in /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py now covers TestPostUpdateAndEarnings (3 tests: full flow, non-owner denied, patient forbidden on earnings).
